context_model.pinned_notes: Loaded/open context blocks Eric may draw from right now; not every note file on disk.
context_model.latest: The growing active conversation/thread after startup context; it may later be saved, cleared, or reset.
context_model.session_notes: Timestamped continuity notes saved under notes/sessions; Connect loads the latest selected note, Connect Previous moves one timestamp back, and Connect Empty omits them.
context_model.ordering_hint: Recent runtime state and tool receipts outrank older notes; pinned notes are nearby, shelf notes are only titles until read.
